In the repository

The project’s working documents live beside the code and change often. They’re written for the people building Pencil, so they’re less polished than these pages.

  • docs/goals.md: what Pencil is for, what’s still open, and how each figure went.
  • docs/design-notes.md: background on the design.
  • README.md: the short version.

Pencil is early, and its syntax will change. Source on GitHub, under the MIT license.
